question_text: Write a summary of the passage in no more than 90 to
stimulus: words. 10 Read the passage and answer the questions 4 and 5. Dr. Qudrat-E-Khuda, born in 1900 in Birbhum, West Bengal, was a great scientist. He passed the Matriculation Examination from Kolkata Madrasa at the age of 18. He obtained his M.Sc. degree in Chemistry securing the gold medal. He obtained the D.Sc Degree in 1929 from London University. He was the Principal of Islamia College and Presidency College, Calcutta in 1947. He was appointed as the scientific advisor to the Ministry of Defense. After the independence of Bangladesh, he was made chairman of the National Education Commission in 1972. He was appointed Visiting Professor of Dhaka University in 1975 and served there till his death in 1977. The government of Bangladesh honoured him with 'Ekushe Padak' in 1976 and 'Swadhinata Dibas Puraskar' in 1984.
